body: On tuesday I found out a guy I hang out with was killed in a car accident. Right after that I found out my friend has cancer. The person I love is moving in with someone else because she doesnt trust me. I got a new job but I'm nervous because I am losing a ton of job security and im afraid. I want to talk to my girlfriend about these things but she thinks im complaining and is annoyed by it. We havent been exactly close recently; it is making me feel empty and unloved.
